facts.fact: The APD, the body supervising Law 2017-020, was acting in April 2025 by diagnosing the education ministry's and the social security fund's processing.
facts.system: Autorite de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel (APD)

facts.fact: Under its Bayanat-Protection compliance programme the APD began diagnosing personal data processing at the education ministry and the social security fund, with no decision stated.
The programme helps data controllers comply with Law 2017-020 on personal data protection, which the APD supervises.
